discoveredSources.title: Truth - Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
discoveredSources.explanation: You can start here for a survey of contemporary literature and key problems.

discoveredSources.title: An Inquiry into the Nature of Truth
discoveredSources.explanation: You will find the central questions about mind-independence and truth criteria here.

discoveredSources.title: Theories of Truth - MIT Press Direct
discoveredSources.explanation: You can use this introduction to grasp the big picture of epistemology.

discoveredSources.title: Truth, correspondence theory of - Routledge Encyclopedia of Philosophy
discoveredSources.explanation: You will learn how truth is analyzed as a connection to reality.

discoveredSources.title: “Coherence Theory of Truth” by Harold H. Joachim - Philosophy Home Page
discoveredSources.explanation: You can examine the coherence theory's focus on logical consistency among beliefs.

discoveredSources.title: “Pragmatic Theory of Truth” by William James - Philosophy Home Page
discoveredSources.explanation: You will understand why pragmatists define truth by practical, useful applications.

discoveredSources.title: The Deflationary Theory of Truth - Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
discoveredSources.explanation: You can study the argument that truth has no hidden metaphysical nature.

discoveredSources.title: Semantic Theory of Truth | Internet Encyclopedia of Philosophy
discoveredSources.explanation: You will find a rigorous formalization of truth for specialized logical languages.

discoveredSources.title: 8.8: Differences Between Truth and Validity - Social Sci LibreTexts
discoveredSources.explanation: You can distinguish between factual accuracy and internal logical consistency.

discoveredSources.title: Philosophy of Post-Truth Yael Brahms - INSS
discoveredSources.explanation: You will see how objective facts compete with emotion in public discourse.

discoverSourcesResults.overview: These resources bridge the gap between classical philosophical theories, modern linguistic analysis, and contemporary political challenges regarding reality.
